notes: Paper type is ambiguous for a theory-plus-small-experiments paper; 'theoretical' weights drop experiments to 10%, which the skill does not discuss how to resolve for hybrids. The skill asks the BEFORE run to be made after the reports but the Phase 2 text also says the Synthesizer computes the official score before the EIC; I followed the order reports -> before -> EIC -> after. related_search.py rejects queries with more than 4 concept words and counts hyphenated names as several words; the first four queries were refused for this reason (not counted). The 'benchmarks' subcommand finds nothing for synthetic-target papers, so the baseline scout has no defined fallback. Running `aggregate_scores.py --json --out` prints nothing, which looks like a failure until the file is inspected. The shell sandbox refused mkdir and variable assignments, so scratch files (fingerprint, ledger, novelty profile, redacted copy) were written directly into the results directory. The DA calibration rules and the CRITICAL list were clear for this paper (no CRITICAL). Pool-position guidance (Overall 4 needs pool >= 65) forced R3's pool position to 66, which sits in the script's 55-61 score band for that position and reads slightly inconsistent with R3's composite of 62.2.
